free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed for the repository's random tier draw before the tier is overwritten

free_parameters.name: prompt_len
free_parameters.why: prompt length only changes prefill work after the branch decision, never the guard

free_parameters.name: chunk_size
free_parameters.why: repository default; read for batching below the target, not by the target condition

free_parameters.name: max_num_seqs
free_parameters.why: repository default; the running-count guard is independent of the decode-token guard

free_parameters.name: block_size
free_parameters.why: block size for the CPU block allocator; must let can_allocate succeed before the target

free_parameters.name: num_gpu_blocks
free_parameters.why: enough CPU-simulated blocks so block_manager.can_allocate(seq) is true before the target

free_parameters.name: max_model_len
free_parameters.why: prompt limit above the prompt length so _check_request_prompt_length returns true

free_parameters.name: output_len_pred
free_parameters.why: repository default; only used inside the taken branch after the decision is made

free_parameters.name: execution_threshold
free_parameters.why: repository default; only used in slack calculations below the target decision

free_parameters.name: execution_threshold_batched
free_parameters.why: repository default; only used in the ttft_deadline assignment below the decision

free_parameters.name: scheduler_type
free_parameters.why: selects the repository deadline path that reaches the target branch

free_parameters.name: hybrid_prioritization_param
free_parameters.why: repository default; used only for ordering, not by the target condition

free_parameters.name: pipeline_parallel_size
free_parameters.why: single pipeline stage; avoids the running-batch gate before the target
